rules.title: Define __all__
rules.text: Define the public API in the package __init__.py with __all__. Adding a symbol there is a deliberate API decision.

rules.title: Explicit file encoding
rules.text: Pass encoding= to text-mode open, read_text and write_text. The default is the locale encoding, not UTF-8.

rules.title: Public docstrings
rules.text: Give public APIs docstrings, with a Raises section for exceptions callers should catch.

rules.title: Keyword-only additions
rules.text: Add new parameters as keyword-only with defaults so positional callers keep working.

rules.title: Typed package
rules.text: Require type hints on all code and ship a py.typed marker.

rules.title: pyproject.toml only
rules.text: Declare metadata and build config in pyproject.toml and avoid setup.py.

rules.title: One docstring style
rules.text: Use one docstring style such as Google and keep types in signatures, not in docstrings.

rules.title: Test every supported Python
rules.text: Test against every supported Python version in CI.

rules.title: Honest dependency bounds
rules.text: Declare only the lower bounds you need and let users upgrade within them.
